name: Coordination / write authority (AX-03, AX-12) — H4 frozen operative content: every write becomes canonical only by passing the single decidable admission predicate BEFORE canonicalization, at one serialization point (physical single writer OR machine-checked-nonforking logical serialization)
families: uncoordinated-concurrent-mutation: agents mutate shared state with no dependency control
LLM-arbitration: majority vote / debate / model-judged conflict resolution as the trusted arbitration

multi-writer-convergent-CRDT: concurrent writers with merge semantics as the canonical store, operations replicated and accepted BEFORE any admission predicate runs (absorbs: Keyhive convergent capabilities, ERA epoch-resolved duelling-admin arbitration, Automerge full-history documents)

deterministic-merge-CRDT-with-admission-at-merge: convergent replication where every operation passes the single decidable admission predicate AT the deterministic total-order merge point, before becoming canonical — canonical state a pure function of the committed operation set (Byzantine-resilient deterministic reconstruction). ADJUDICATION under frozen H4 (CA P1-7): the family QUALIFIES — the deterministic merge is the one serialization point and admission precedes canonicalization — so it SURVIVES as an admissible family, structurally distinct from shipped CRDTs. No shipped member instantiates it; K-CRDT's members do not

single-writer-kernel-arbitration: one kernel-enforced writer seat with a total, pure, decidable admission predicate; confluent deterministic tiered parallelism (antichain + disjoint footprints + atomic tier commit), extensible per the v2 AX-03 correction to deterministic conflict-ordered execution (Calvin-class pre-committed serialization order over non-commuting effects); every acceptance AND refusal a signed, durable derivation (absorbs: Cedar-in-Lean verified policy/authorization kernel candidate, accountable-human-decision-authority protocol objects candidate — maker-checker, quorum sign-off, delegation lattices, Faramesh non-bypassable action-authorization boundary, dissent-preservation/voting/deliberation primitives candidate as typed institutional-arbitration objects, semantic-conflict isolation ordered by the lex superior/posterior/specialis authority lattice candidate, MSC-projection deadlock-free coordination)

bft-replicated-total-order: consensus-ordered log (Mysticeti-class) realizing one LOGICAL writer across mutually distrusting operators, admission evaluated at consensus commit (absorbs: heterogeneous/asymmetric quorum declarations at the membership layer); explicitly named by the v2 AX-03 ceiling's 'single logical serialization point' wording (CF P1-1)

eliminations.lemma: Violates H5 and H4 (frozen wording): committed output depends on interleaving of non-commuting effects, hence is not a function of frozen inputs (unreplayable), and no admission-before-canonicalization point exists anywhere. This is also the shipped tree's named residual at its seat (parallel-executor.lisp shared-context mutation), carried as an open obligation against K-B0-SHIPPED, not silently absorbed.

Violates H1: statistical arbitration in the trusted path — replayable statistical judgment is still statistical judgment, and H1 alone carries the elimination. The v1 H8 conjunct ('a vote is not an offline-recomputable derivation') is WITHDRAWN as false (CA P2-10): with OMS-pinned weights and batch-invariant kernels, recorded ballots and tallies ARE offline-recomputable; a false conjunct in a lemma invites exactly the adversarial reopening it received. Conformal social choice (arXiv 2604.07667) yields distribution-level guarantees only and survives as an untrusted advisory layer.

Violates H4 under its FROZEN operative wording: shipped CRDTs replicate and accept operations before any admission predicate runs — merge-after-acceptance, not admission-before-canonicalization at a serialization point. Under the same frozen wording K-BFT qualifies (admission at consensus commit, one logical serialization point with machine-checked nonforking): the v1 asymmetry — 'logical single writer' granted to BFT and denied to CRDTs with the discriminator unstated (CA P1-7) — is repaired by stating the discriminator, making this lemma a proof instead of taste. The newly enumerated deterministic-merge-CRDT-with-admission-at-merge family is NOT covered by this elimination and survives. K-CRDT is RETAINED in D_T as a comparison member with genuinely superior properties on specific rungs (offline operation, tamper-evidence without quorum), weighed axis-by-axis.
